prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 个人所得税专项附加扣除标准简表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "扣除项目" spans 1 col × 2 row; "每月标准（元）" spans 2 col × 1 row; "适用条件" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "扣除项目" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 133px
  col 2: header "每月标准（元） › 一般地区" · longest unbreakable word 37px · one-line width 203px
  col 3: header "每月标准（元） › 特殊情形" · longest unbreakable word 48px · one-line width 435px
  col 4: header "适用条件" · longest unbreakable word 39px · one-line width 1038px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"汇总个人所得税专项附加扣除的月度标准及适用条件，供读者查询和比较。","reading":"读者先按扣除项目定位行，再横向比较一般地区与特殊情形的标准，最后查看适用条件；较长条件可能撑高行，可利用同一行的高度容纳标准中的换行。","groups":["第二、三列同属“每月标准（元）”，应作为一组比较；特殊情形通常需要更多文字空间。","第一列是行标题，与同一行的标准和条件共同构成查询单位。"],"keep_intact":["金额数字及其单位","扣除项目名称中的关键词","适用条件中的数字和完整术语"],"may_wrap":["较长的扣除项目名称","金额后的括号说明","特殊情形的说明","适用条件的长句"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [75, 72, 96, 116] · table 360×1756px · row heights [36, 60, 246, 246, 315, 292, 269, 292] · column headers wrapped 2/5 · tallest cell 13 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [88, 60, 69, 142] · table 360×1500px · row heights [36, 60, 246, 199, 246, 246, 222, 246] · column headers wrapped 2/5 · tallest cell 10 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [66, 91, 116, 86] · table 360×2453px · row heights [36, 36, 385, 362, 432, 408, 385, 408] · column headers wrapped 1/5 · tallest cell 18 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"特殊情形列有足够空间呈现大部分金额和说明；适用条件虽长，行与行的对应关系仍清楚。","problems":"适用条件窄而密，形成很高的文字块；行标题也多次折成三行，一般地区表头折行。","cause":"第四列仅116px，条件长句频繁换行并主导行高；第一列75px、第二列72px对较长项目名和表头都偏紧。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"适用条件更易连贯阅读，行高明显下降；第一列较宽，项目名称更容易辨认，整体是三者中最均衡的起点。","problems":"两个标准列过窄，表头和括号说明挤成短行；特殊情形中的金额与说明难以快速扫描，部分长项目名仍折成多行。","cause":"第四列142px改善了长句，但第二、三列分别只有60px和69px，扣除内边距后可用文字宽度很小。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"两个标准列较宽，金额及其说明更容易横向比较；第二层表头也保持单行。","problems":"适用条件被挤成狭窄长条，造成极高的行和其他列大量空白；第一列项目名也被切成许多短行，整行难以作为单位阅读。","cause":"第二、三列合计占207px，留给第四列仅86px、第一列仅66px；尤其第四列不足以承载占字数最多的条件。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"平衡条件与特殊情形","widths":[81,65,78,135],"change":"以r0B为基础，适度收窄项目列和条件列，给特殊情形多9px、一般地区多5px，缓解标准说明和表头的拥挤，同时保留条件列的阅读宽度。"},{"name":"优先条件阅读","widths":[80,60,75,144],"change":"保留较宽的适用条件列，并从项目列调出空间给特殊情形；检验条件长句的连贯性与标准列可读性之间的取舍。"},{"name":"标准列更从容","widths":[78,70,85,126],"change":"进一步扩大两个标准列，尤其是特殊情形列，让金额和括号说明更易扫描；用126px条件列检验是否仍能维持可接受的行高。"}]}
